This '''starship''' was owned and operated by [[Malak (Rodian)|Malak]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]], circa [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Flying this [[Starship/Legends|ship]], Malak visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] to capture native [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssins]]. After a successful hunt, she flew the ship to [[Kinun Depot]], where she [[Fuel/Legends|refueled]] it. An Abyssin [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], [[Myo/Legends|Myo]], escaped Malak's ship there.
